notes.title: Case 3: The Remorseful Doctor
notes.content:
We’ve added a new full case to investigate![p align="start"]In The Remorseful Doctor, you’ll look into the mysterious death of Danton, a heart surgeon who worked for the Zeus Health Alliance. Details are limited and the circumstances aren’t clear. Your job is to piece together what happened.
[p align="start"]What’s in this update:

New full-length case: The Remorseful Doctor

New dialogues, documents, and interviews to review

Additional contradictions to spot and debunk

General bug fixes
[p align="start"]Thanks for playing and for your continued feedback!
